newsitem.title: USA: PepsiCo in marketing alliance with baseball.
newsitem.headline: PepsiCo in marketing alliance with baseball.

text.p: PepsiCo Inc's Pepsi-Cola Co said Wednesday it entered into a five-year marketing alliance with Major League Baseball, making Pepsi baseball's official soft drink and giving the company exclusive rights to use Major League Baseball's trademarks.

The company said in a release that the new relationship provides Pepsi exclusive rights to Major League Baseball's All-Star balloting effort, which the company will use to execute a nationwide promotion.
As part of the marketing partnership, Pepsi said it has made a "substantial commitment" to advertise on national television broadcasts of Major League Baseball games.

The company also said it will produce a series of "baseball themed" television commercials to begin airing in the 1998 season. The company added it will support Major League Baseball with broadcast sponsorships.
